raw_response:
I farm the way I have done for years: I start from last year, then I change a little if I have water and money in hand. I only have 7 mu and 2 people at home, so I cannot spread myself too thin. Cotton is still my main crop, because if I manage water and insects well, it brings cash. Wheat and maize I keep too, because they steady the year and everyone around here plants them, so I can see clearly what works. I went to primary school, so I do listen a bit to the seed dealer and the village people, but I still trust what I saw in nearby fields. I will use improved or hybrid seed where neighbors got better stands, and I will not cut fertilizer too hard. Fertilizer costs money, but losing yield costs more. Since I have well irrigation, I will give water at the key times and keep cotton a bit heavier on fertilizer and pesticide than the grain crops.
